albums.name: Kiss Land
albums.description: On the BBC Radio 1 interview with Zane Lowe Abel mentioned that chronologically, "The Town" would be the last song on the album. Also, leaked instrumental of the song has a transition from "Pretty" in the beginning. All of that allows us to speculate that a version of the tracklist with "The Town" as the last track could exist.

albums.name: Kiss Land (Deluxe)
albums.description: Possible original tracklist for the Deluxe edition of 'Kiss Land', based off the Work IDs on ASCAP. Lists all the songs in the same order, Pharrel Remix of "Wanderlust" and two unreleased songs: "Heavenly Creatures" and "Pure Life". Work ID between "Wanderlust" Remix and "Heavenly Creatures" isn't listed, but can be assumed to still be "Odd Look", and "Professional" has an entirely separate ID.
